sides.snippet: he shall bring his trespass offering to Yahweh, a ram without blemish from the flock
sides.verseText: \"If anyone commits a trespass, and sins unwittingly, in the holy things of Yahweh; then he shall bring his trespass offering to Yahweh, a ram without blemish from the flock, according to your estimation in silver by shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary, for a trespass offering.

sides.snippet: he shall offer a female goat a year old for a sin-offering.
sides.verseText: If one person sin unwittingly, then he shall offer a female goat a year old for a sin-offering.
